technical.summary: Strong long-term trend structure (golden cross, ADX 41.86, above major MAs) but weakened by price positioning below short-term EMAs and stochrsi oversold condition; moderate swing entry with caution on momentum divergence.

fundamental.summary: APTV shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 83 days—insufficient fundamental or smart money conviction to support a trade.

sentiment.summary: Mixed congressional activity from junior member with no clear directional bias; market sentiment neutral with greed reading; insufficient data for actionable signal.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (194.7) indicates extreme market stress, and earnings in 83 days presents binary event risk; Consumer Discretionary sector particularly vulnerable in this environment.

debate.key_bull_argument: Golden cross with ADX 41.86 and price above 200-EMA establish strong long-term uptrend structure that historically precedes sustained rallies.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis at 194.7), zero fundamental conviction, price below all short-term EMAs with stochrsi oversold, and 83-day earnings binary event create unacceptable risk/reward for swing entry.

decision.entry_rationale: Golden cross and ADX 41.86 show structural uptrend, but price positioning below all short-term EMAs with stochrsi oversold undermines swing entry quality. Macro environment (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis) and zero fundamental conviction make risk/reward unfavorable.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings binary event in 83 days combined with inverted yield curve recession signals and VIX crisis levels create unacceptable tail risk for Consumer Discretionary swing trade.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case
